name: meridian-browser
description: Meridian MCP bridge (mcp/meridian-mcp.js), the stand-alone stdio server MCP directories list. The browser itself is built from chromium/.

scripts.serve: python3 site/build.py > /dev/null && echo "Serving the site at http://localhost:${PORT:-8000}/" && python3 -m http.server ${PORT:-8000} -d docs
scripts.lab: python3 site/build.py > /dev/null && echo "Design lab at http://localhost:${PORT:-8010}/site/lab/" && python3 -m http.server ${PORT:-8010}
scripts.test:py: uv run --no-project --with pytest==8.4.2 --with pytest-cov==7.0.0 python -m pytest tests/site/py --cov=site --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.test:site: npm run test:py && npm run test:node && npm run test:web
